art_direction: 柔浅桃底，铜沙侧带，手作笔缘微伏，安然正视。
composition_variation: Give the left eye a low, softly scooped opening and the right twelve percent greater height and breadth. Set both pupils centered in a steady forward gaze. Vary the black upper brush edges with a single slight pressure wobble, keeping their broad silhouettes opaque and controlled. Identical #BC946F iris side bands flank the large pupils; each has one elongated ivory glint. Keep inner bands slightly slimmer. Use a clearly visible but gentle soft peach paper background, matching the exact palette below. Do not wash it out to white. Keep it flat and quiet with no gradients or decorative marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
